# Initial group checkpoint

`group.tfstate` is an unchanged Terraform-generated checkpoint, not a handwritten
state model. It was generated with Terraform 1.13.5 and this repository's provider
(production resource implementation from commit
`c98615591f4eaaf583836cae2c04c230b67cded1`), using the create configuration and
HTTP fixtures in
[continuation_and_cleanup.yaml](../../expected_errors/engine/continuation_and_cleanup.yaml).
Only the successful `create` step was used to generate it.

The create ran against a local fixture server with fixed fake IDs and no live
Databricks credentials or resources. The checkpoint includes Terraform's own
lineage, private data, and a loopback URL; none were rewritten. Its SHA-256 is
`01452ea62c0c938a80978d9b55cb35ec4d94923aaab986c4470a19dda2c804c6`.

This fixture proves restoration of nonempty state; it is not a historical-schema
migration fixture. A migration regression should keep a checkpoint generated by
the specific older provider version, with its provenance documented alongside it.
Do not refresh such a checkpoint just to make a migration test pass.
